result.email_draft:
Subject: Price Discrepancy on Invoice AC-8007 – PO-2026-1007

Dear Accounts Receivable Team,

With reference to purchase order PO-2026-1007, invoice AC-8007 dated October 8, 2026, totaling USD 2,200.00, is currently on hold due to a pricing discrepancy.

Item CHR-100 was invoiced at USD 22.00 per unit, whereas the agreed purchase order price is USD 20.00 per unit. For 100 units, this results in a difference of USD 200.00.

Please confirm the correct unit price for CHR-100, as the invoice reflects USD 22.00 while the agreed price is USD 20.00. If the agreed price is USD 20.00, please issue a credit note for the USD 200.00 difference or provide a corrected invoice.

Kind regards,
